'''Yir Tangee''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Yir Tangee system/Legends|Yir Tangee system]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Havriso Looruya]] was appointed to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate's]] [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]]&mdash;a committee to assist with the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|crisis]] of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists']] attempts to secede from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;as a representative of Yir Tangee. Looruya was discovered funding Separatist territories after being accused by Senator [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] of the planet [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], leading to Looruya's stepping down from the committee.

==Description==
Yir Tangee was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Heroes">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref> in the [[Yir Tangee system/Legends|Yir Tangee system]] of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HNNDate1">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|news/13328_1.html|Palpatine forms Loyalist Committee}} is set on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "13:3:28," which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] formed the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]], a group of [[Senator/Legends|senators]] from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to assist in negotiations for the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|crisis]]<ref name="HNN 49" /> caused by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists']] attempts to secede from the Republic.<ref name="Crisis">{{CSWECite|I|137|Confederacy of Independent Systems (CIS)}}</ref> Senator [[Havriso Looruya]] was appointed to the committee as a representative of Yir Tangee, a fact published in the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of the forty-ninth issue of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] volume 531.<ref name="HNN 49" />

[[File:OnacondaFarr-AOTC.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Onaconda Farr (pictured) exposed Yir Tangee's representative in the Loyalist Committee as having Separatist ties.]]
Later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="HNNDate2">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|news/1352_2.html|Rodian Senator Uncovers Loyalist-Separatist Ties}} is set on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "13:5:2," which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> Senator [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] of<ref name="HNN 54">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|news/1352_2.html|Rodian Senator Uncovers Loyalist-Separatist Ties}}</ref> the planet<ref name="Rodia">{{CSWECite|III|105|Rodia}}</ref> [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] accused Looruya of funding Separatists on<ref name="HNN 54" /> the planets<ref name="Ando&Sy">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_1.html|Ando, Sy Myrth Secede}}</ref><ref name="Sluis">{{CSWECite|III|169|Sluissi}}</ref> [[Ando/Legends|Ando]], [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]], and [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]], which was confirmed by the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]]. Looruya and his legal consul provided no comment and isolated themselves at the Yir Tangee [[Ambassador/Legends|embassy]]. The accusations and Looruya's actions were documented in the fifty-fourth issue of the HoloNet News.<ref name="HNN 54" /> Looruya was criticized<ref name="HNN 55">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|news/1359_4.html|Senator Farr Named to Loyalist Committee}}</ref> and stepped down from his position,<ref name="Rodia" /> which was thereafter filled by Farr, who was representing Rodia. Yir Tangee's replacement in the Loyalist Committee was reported in the next issue of the HoloNet News.<ref name="HNN 55" />

A few years after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|defeat]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]<ref name="Heroes" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Keoulkeech]] visited [[Salfur's Trading Post]],<ref name="Heroes" /> a landing platform operated by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cobb Salfur]].<ref name="Geo">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> While at the platform, Keoulkeech saw the ''[[Sudden Restoration]]'',<ref name="Heroes" /> a [[Hospital ship/Legends|hospital ship]] created by members of the medically advanced [[Carosite]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Alien">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> preparing medical supplies for the ravaged Yir Tangee. The shaman subsequently joined the medical [[Frigate/Legends|frigate's]] journey to bring medical aid to worlds suffering from the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Heroes" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yir Tangee was first mentioned in ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', a [[1995]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook written by [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] and [[Paul Sudlow]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Heroes" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Yir Tangee [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square L-8.<ref name="Atlas" />
